Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies: Etiology
agent not fully characterized
smaller than smallest known virus
ellicits no detectable immune or inflammatory response in the host
resistant to most disinfectants and treatments which normally destroy nucleic acids

Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies: Agent Theories
VIRUS - unconventional, unusual biochemical and biopysical properties
VIRINO - host-derived protein coat coupled to a small noncoding regulatory nucleic acid
PRION - host-coded normal cellular protein becomes partially protease resistant through post tranlational conformation change
